data.title: PROJECT LARKMOOR
data.text:
PROJECT LARKMOOR. Strictly confidential.
Fund IV is preparing an offer for Larkmoor Wharf, a waterfront office and logistics property.
Financing needed at the indicative price: $42.5 million senior loan. Contacts: Odile Farrant (Fund IV), Ruaridh Penhallow (seller's broker).
Credit committee meets the week of 7 December.
Research needed: what do lenders charge on commercial real estate loans, what are cap rates and vacancy for
office and logistics property, and what do comparable properties sell for per square foot?
Ref: a17f1b24f16e3a18
